# This is a true allow list with things that we really don't care about.
# `allowlist_todo.txt` is autogenerated by `stubtest --generate-allowlist`
# and might contain actual problems and things that we *do want* to fix.
#
# Please, move things here when you are sure that they really should be ignored.
# Comments about why things are ignored are mandatory.

# Constructor arguments *appear* optional but actually throw exception
rest_framework.relations.ManyRelatedField.__init__
rest_framework.relations.SlugRelatedField.__init__

# None is used as a placeholder, but not valid in actual usage
rest_framework.parsers.BaseParser.media_type
rest_framework.renderers.BaseRenderer.format
rest_framework.renderers.BaseRenderer.media_type
rest_framework.validators.BaseUniqueForValidator.message
# `@action(detail=...)` is required at runtime (asserts non-None), so the stub
# marks `detail: bool` without a default even though the runtime signature is
# `detail=None`. The stub also promotes `suffix` / `name` from `**kwargs` to
# named keyword parameters for better editor support.
rest_framework.decorators.action

# Migrations are omitted
rest_framework.authtoken.migrations
rest_framework.authtoken.migrations.0001_initial
rest_framework.authtoken.migrations.0002_auto_20160226_1747
rest_framework.authtoken.migrations.0003_tokenproxy
rest_framework.authtoken.migrations.0004_alter_tokenproxy_options

# `empty` hinted as enum, to work correctly in unions:
# https://github.com/typeddjango/djangorestframework-stubs/issues/42
rest_framework.fields.empty

# Mypy doesn't like default value `empty`
rest_framework.fields.DateField.__init__
rest_framework.fields.DateTimeField.__init__
rest_framework.fields.DurationField.__init__
rest_framework.fields.TimeField.__init__

# Generated objects:
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token@AnnotatedWith
rest_framework.authtoken.models.TokenProxy@AnnotatedWith

# .save() will be different soon:
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.save

# Stub-only synthetic types (Protocols, TypeAliases, TypedDicts, base Meta),
# intentionally not present at runtime. They exist to give better types to
# users of the library.
# Most such symbols are marked with `@typing.type_check_only`, but that
# decorator can't be applied to `TypeAlias` assignments, so `Validator`
# stays here. `ModelSerializer.Meta` is present at runtime as a subclass
# hook but stubtest can't reconcile its stub-only class attributes.
rest_framework.serializers.ModelSerializer.Meta
rest_framework.validators.Validator

# Model field descriptor mismatches: django-stubs types model fields as their
# `Field` subclass, but at runtime Django replaces them with
# `DeferredAttribute` / `ForwardOneToOneDescriptor` / `ForeignKeyDeferredAttribute`
# / property. This is a known django-stubs limitation and can only be fixed
# there, not in drf-stubs.
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.created
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.key
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.user
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.user_id
rest_framework.authtoken.models.TokenProxy.pk
rest_framework.authtoken.models.TokenProxy.user_id

# django-stubs synthesizes `get_next_by_<field>` / `get_previous_by_<field>`
# helpers without the internal `field` / `is_next` keyword-only parameters that
# `functools.partialmethod` binds at runtime. This is a django-stubs concern.
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.get_next_by_created
rest_framework.authtoken.models.Token.get_previous_by_created
rest_framework.authtoken.models.TokenProxy.get_next_by_created
rest_framework.authtoken.models.TokenProxy.get_previous_by_created

# `User = get_user_model()` resolves to a dynamic model class at runtime, but
# the stubs annotate it as the abstract base class for typing purposes. There
# is no clean way to express this in stubs.
rest_framework.authtoken.admin.User
rest_framework.authtoken.management.commands.drf_create_token.UserModel

# Only defined at runtime when the optional `markdown` package is installed.
# The stubs unconditionally expose them (guarded by `try: import markdown`),
# which is the desired behaviour for downstream typing.
rest_framework.compat.CodeBlockPreprocessor
rest_framework.compat.apply_markdown
rest_framework.compat.__all__

# `api_settings` is a `LazySettings`-style proxy: the runtime object is
# `APISettings`, but the stubs expose it via the `_Settings` protocol/alias so
# that user code sees the individual setting attributes with their proper types.
rest_framework.settings.api_settings
rest_framework.negotiation.DefaultContentNegotiation.settings

# `SimpleRateThrottle.cache` is `django.core.cache.caches[...]` at runtime,
# which returns a `ConnectionProxy` that transparently proxies to a `BaseCache`.
# Typing it as `BaseCache` is the correct user-facing type.
rest_framework.throttling.SimpleRateThrottle.cache
